install: sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export DOTNET_ROOT="$HOME/.dotnet"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export DOTNET_ROOT="$HOME/.dotnet"' >> ~/.bashrc; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$HOME/.dotnet/tools:$PATH"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$HOME/.dotnet/tools:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc; grep -qxF 'export DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT="1"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT="1"' >> ~/.bashrc; grep -qxF 'export DOTNET_NOLOGO="1"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export DOTNET_NOLOGO="1"' >> ~/.bashrc; export DOTNET_ROOT="$HOME/.dotnet" PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$HOME/.dotnet/tools:$PATH" DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT="1" DOTNET_NOLOGO="1"; curl -fsSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh | bash -s -- --jsonfile global.json --install-dir "$HOME/.dotnet"; dotnet restore HackPDM.sln; if [ ! -d "$HOME/pgdata" ] && [ -x /usr/lib/postgresql/15/bin/initdb ]; then /usr/lib/postgresql/15/bin/initdb -D "$HOME/pgdata" -U postgres --auth=trust && echo "unix_socket_directories = '/tmp'" >> "$HOME/pgdata/postgresql.conf" && echo "listen_addresses = 'localhost'" >> "$HOME/pgdata/postgresql.conf"; fi; if [ ! -d "$HOME/odoo-16.0" ]; then git clone --depth 1 --branch 16.0 https://github.com/odoo/odoo.git "$HOME/odoo-16.0"; fi; if [ ! -d "$HOME/odoo-venv" ] && command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv venv "$HOME/odoo-venv" --python python3 && grep -v '^python-ldap' "$HOME/odoo-16.0/requirements.txt" > /tmp/odoo-req.txt && uv pip install --python "$HOME/odoo-venv/bin/python" -r /tmp/odoo-req.txt 'numpy<2.1' 'sqlalchemy>=2,<3' webdavclient3 python-magic 'setuptools<80' wheel && rm -f /tmp/odoo-req.txt; fi
